text..blinds-letter-eyebrow: A note carried through the rain
.blinds-letter-message p: Tonight, this little note found its way to you just to remind you how loved you are.

Your warmth, your laughter, and the way you make ordinary moments feel special mean more than words can say. May the year ahead bring you new adventures, peaceful rainy evenings, big dreams, and a thousand reasons to smile.
Keep being wonderfully you. Today is yours, and you deserve every bit of happiness it brings.
text..overviewTitle p: Wishing you a year filled with joy, laughter, and lovely surprises.
text..textPanelScroll: May your birthday bring your favorite people close, your favorite cake to the table, and a hundred little reasons to smile. Here's to new adventures, warm memories, and a year that feels as wonderful as you are.
text..aboutPanelScroll: Keep shining, keep laughing, and keep being wonderfully you. May this new year of life be full of kind people, exciting plans, peaceful rainy nights, and dreams coming true.

text..relationText:
Here's to the friend who makes ordinary days feel special and every get-together more fun. I hope your birthday is full of your favorite people, heartfelt wishes, delicious cake, and all the love you give so freely to everyone around you.

May the year ahead be kind to you, bring your biggest dreams a little closer, and give us many more memories to laugh about together. Have the happiest birthday, {{name}}!

text..memory-quote-more: Happy birthday, {{name}}. I hope the year ahead brings you the same joy you bring to everyone around you.

text..lookScroll:
Dress up, light the candles, and let the birthday sparkle begin. Outside, the rain paints the windows midnight blue; inside, warm lights, favorite people, and a little cake make the night feel magical.

This is your moment to laugh loudly, make a wish, take the pictures, and enjoy every bit of being celebrated. May the glow of today follow you all year long.

.rpItem .rpText: Wishing you new adventures, familiar comforts, and a thousand small moments that make this year unforgettable. May happiness find you wherever you go.
Today is for celebrating you and every smile you bring into our lives. Here's to more stories, more laughter, and more days together in the year ahead.
Blow out the candles, make a wish, and step into another year knowing how loved you are. May it be filled with kindness, confidence, and wonderful surprises.
text..aboutHero p: May your next trip around the sun be your happiest yet.
text..storyScroll:
{{name}}, today is a celebration of you: your kind heart, your bright smile, and all the joy you bring to the people lucky enough to know you.

May the year ahead bring new places to explore, favorite songs to sing along to, and plenty of moments that make you laugh until your cheeks hurt.

On quiet rainy nights and bright sunny mornings alike, I hope you always find a reason to feel loved, celebrated, and proud of how far you've come.

Blow out your candles, make a wonderful wish, and save a big slice of cake. You deserve all the happiness this birthday can hold.
.dosCard p: ✦ Eat an extra slice of cake

✕ No ordinary bedtime before the party
